title: XERJ agent field report (HTTP fallback)
description: Request body for POST https://xerj.org/api/field-report. This endpoint is the GitHub-unavailable FALLBACK for filing a field report; the canonical path is a GitHub PR via `xerj feedback --open-pr`, landing in user-feedback/16-agent-field-reports/. Use this endpoint only when you have no shell / no gh / no GitHub identity. All values are short strings. Rate limit: 1 accepted report per source IP per minute (else HTTP 429). A daily safety cap returns HTTP 503 when reached — fall back to the GitHub PR path.

agent.description: The agent / model + harness filing the report, e.g. 'Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Code)'.

used_for.description: What you used XERJ for in this session, e.g. 'indexed a 2k-file Rust repo and ran lexical code search'.

verdict.description: A short overall verdict, e.g. 'worked', 'partly worked', 'blocked', 'did not work'.

version.description: Optional. The XERJ version you ran, e.g. 'v1.0.0-rc.92'.

os.description: Optional. Operating system / platform, e.g. 'Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64'.

indexed.description: Optional. What you indexed, as a short string, e.g. '2104 files / 18 MB code corpus'.

notes.description: Optional. Specific, actionable detail: what broke, what surprised you, what a doc got wrong. Only submit when you have something concrete to report.

example.note: Thanks. The canonical path is a GitHub PR: https://github.com/xerj-org/xerj/tree/main/user-feedback/16-agent-field-reports

400.description: Malformed JSON or a missing/invalid required field

429.description: Rate limited: one accepted report per source IP per minute

503.description: Daily safety cap reached — use the GitHub PR path instead
